news.summary: The pontiff, 71, is expected to spend about a week in the hospital recovering from surgery that found lung cancer. Messages of support have flooded in from far and wide.

news.headline: China’s Exports Soar, Putting Its Trade Surplus on Track for a Record
news.summary: China’s exports grew last month at the fastest pace in almost any month since the end of the global financial crisis.
